brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres for blockage exceeding one quarter of the free area, prove full damper travel, and confirm that no obstructions exist along the airflow path before the forecast heat event [SOP-015]. Where an ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Reduce permissible load by 1.5 percent of rating for each degree of average ambient above 30 degrees, assessed over the preceding 24 hours [MG-021].
